ability.infinity.time_stone.time_race.de: Left (aim): place a numbered gate with a giant green clock face (up to 12; gate 1 is start and finish). Right: menu to start the race or clear the course. Alt+scroll: laps (1 to 5). After the 3-2-1 countdown anyone who runs through the start gate joins; each lap is timed, a green ghost of the best run races alongside and the ranking is shown only to the participants. Sneak + left clears the course.
ability.infinity.time_stone.temporal_lag: Left (aim at a player or creature): for 12 s everything the target does happens late (Alt+scroll: 1 to 4 s). Movement, attacks and item use arrive late; a green clock and afterimages trail them. Right: for 8 s you get the inverse, an aura in which projectiles and nearby creatures are shown 1 s ahead as prediction ghosts.
Mind + Reality conjunction. Left: start / stop. While on, blocks of golden-red light appear on the face you look at, forming bridges, stairs and shelters (up to 64 at a time). They drop nothing and vanish with a shimmer after 60 s. Right: switch brush (single, line, wall, stairs). Alt+scroll: brush size (1 to 3).
ability.infinity.power_stone.time_bomb.d: Power + Time conjunction. Left (aim): plant a purple-green bomb with a floating clock counting down (Alt+scroll: 3 to 10 s); the ticking speeds up. The blast is a shockwave with a huge knockback and light damage, and breaks no blocks. Right: detonate all your bombs now. Maximum 3.
ability.infinity.reality_stone.reincarna: Reality + Soul conjunction. Your tamed pets that die are recorded (up to 20) with name, armour, collar and variant. Left: menu of the fallen companions. Right: the same menu, newest first. Picking one plays the soul-and-body animation and brings it back next to you. Each death can be undone once.
ability.infinity.space_stone.deja_vu.des: Left (aim): mark a sphere (Alt+scroll: radius 4 to 16) with a blue-green ring and remember the blocks, creatures and players inside it. After 10 s, with a clock dome counting down, everything returns to the marked moment: broken or placed blocks, positions, health and inventories. Right: return now. Blocks inside other people's claims are left alone.
